lesson: Dividend-consistent close features do not improve the fixed policy. Full transform adds173 exposure sessions,loses Calmar/growth/depth/recovery,and is dominated by eligibility-only partial control. Better feature arithmetic is not automatic financial alpha; raw fills and cash accounting stayed unchanged.
